name: florida-save-our-homes-by-county-2026
title: Florida Save Our Homes Benefit by County (2026)

sources.title: Florida Department of Revenue, Property Tax Oversight, Data Book and NAL roll files

resources.name: counties
resources.description: 67 counties x roll years 2022 to 2026 (335 rows)

fields.name: county
fields.description: County name as DOR spells it (Miami-Dade, Saint Johns, Saint Lucie, DeSoto)

fields.name: year
fields.description: Tax roll year (assessment date January 1 of that year). 2026 is the preliminary roll

fields.name: homestead_parcels
fields.description: Parcels with NAL field JV_HMSTD (Just Value, Homestead Property) greater than 0. 2026 only

fields.name: homestead_just_value_total
fields.description: Sum of JV_HMSTD over those parcels, in dollars. 2026 only

fields.name: homestead_assessed_value_total
fields.description: Sum of AV_HMSTD (Assessed Value, Homestead Property) before exemptions, in dollars. 2026 only

fields.name: soh_differential_total
fields.description: County Save Our Homes differential (homestead just value minus capped assessed value) as DOR reports it in the Data Book, county_overview.xlsx, sheet Save Our Homes Value History

fields.name: avg_soh_differential_per_homestead
fields.description: (homestead_just_value_total minus homestead_assessed_value_total) divided by homestead_parcels, all from the NAL. 2026 only

fields.name: avg_total_millage
fields.description: DOR Total Millage Rate for the county (county-wide plus less-than-county-wide levies averaged over the county), from millage_taxes_levied.xlsx. 2022 to 2025

fields.name: est_avg_annual_tax_saved
fields.description: ESTIMATE. avg_soh_differential_per_homestead x the county's 2025 Total Millage Rate / 1000, in dollars a year. 2026 only

fields.name: source
fields.description: Table, sheet and column for every figure in the row

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: DOR file URLs, separated by ' | '

fields.name: note
fields.description: Roll status, what is blank and why, and the NAL versus Data Book gap for 2026

resources.name: distribution_2026
resources.description: 2026 parcel-level distribution of the differential per county, from the DOR NAL roll

fields.name: roll
fields.description: Preliminary or Final (Final for Citrus only)

fields.name: homestead_parcels
fields.description: Parcels with JV_HMSTD greater than 0

fields.name: median_soh_differential
fields.description: Median of JV_HMSTD minus AV_HMSTD over homestead parcels

fields.name: p25_soh_differential
fields.description: 25th percentile of the differential

fields.name: p75_soh_differential
fields.description: 75th percentile of the differential

fields.name: p90_soh_differential
fields.description: 90th percentile of the differential

fields.name: p99_soh_differential
fields.description: 99th percentile of the differential

fields.name: max_soh_differential
fields.description: Largest single-parcel differential, as recorded on the roll

fields.name: share_with_zero_differential
fields.description: Share of homestead parcels whose differential is zero or less

fields.name: parcels_differential_over_500k
fields.description: Homestead parcels whose differential exceeds the $500,000 portability limit

fields.name: share_over_500k
fields.description: parcels_differential_over_500k divided by homestead_parcels

fields.name: differential_above_500k_total
fields.description: Sum over those parcels of the differential above $500,000, the part portability cannot carry

fields.description: Median AV_HMSTD
